title: mentha aquatica var. weiheana
intro: Mentha aquatica var. weiheana, commonly known as Water Mint, is a variety of the Water Mint plant, native to Europe and Asia. It has been used in traditional medicine to alleviate digestive issues, promote respiratory health, and reduce inflammation. The health benefits of Water Mint include its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as soothing sore throats and relieving nausea. The bioactive constituents of Water Mint include menthone, menthol, and limonene, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
